subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be a delivery-only `dmThreadMode`, or a unified mode that also creates thread-scoped OpenClaw sessions?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96843 propose different public option names and materially different session behavior for the same user-visible goal.

options.title: Use unified thread sessions
options.body: Consolidate on one mode where each Google Chat DM thread has isolated OpenClaw session state and replies remain in that thread.

options.title: Keep delivery-only threading
options.body: Accept this narrower option while clearly documenting that all visible DM threads still share one OpenClaw session.

options.title: Defer both options
options.body: Retain current non-threaded DM replies until real API evidence and the long-term configuration semantics are settled.

recommendation.title: Use unified thread sessions
recommendation.body: Consolidate on one mode where each Google Chat DM thread has isolated OpenClaw session state and replies remain in that thread.

likelyOwner.reason: They verified and helped land the prior Google Chat DM thread-delivery behavior, making them the strongest available owner for deciding whether to reverse or generalize it.
